Practised estimating a collection using groups of 10 as a guide.
Ananya gave 3 unaided correct responses across 6 attempts.

end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group, such as 10, to estimate a larger collection without counting every object. Ananya explained that an estimate is a close guess, not an exact count, and later used 7 groups of 10 to say about 70; the earlier mix-up of counting groups as single objects was corrected later in the lesson. At home, show a small collection and ask Ananya to group it in tens before estimating.
